definitions.explanation: A person's normal, baseline body temperature when healthy, typically around 36-37°C.

examples.japanese: {平熱|へいねつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: My temperature went back to normal.
My normal body temperature is 36.2 degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧{平熱|へいねつ}になった。
examples.english: After taking medicine, my fever went down and returned to normal.

notes:
FORMS:
{平|へい} (normal, ordinary) + ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat, temperature).

USAGE:
Commonly used in medical and everyday health contexts. In Japan, body temperature is measured in Celsius. Normal temperature ({平熱|へいねつ}) is generally considered to be around 36°C to 37°C.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平熱|へいねつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (to return to normal temperature)
- {平熱|へいねつ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (higher than normal temperature)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧ (high fever)
- ⟦{微熱|びねつ}→微熱：12513_binetsu⟧ (slight fever)
- ⟦{発熱|はつねつ}→発熱：06297_hatsunetsu⟧ (onset of fever)
